# Humanity’s Atlas

> A living timeline of 115 historical figures who redirected humanity — law, faith, science, liberation, and ideas. Search any name. Biographies use public Wikipedia, Wikidata, and Wikiquote only.

Site: https://humanitysatlas.com/

## Pages
- Homepage timeline: https://humanitysatlas.com/
- Search any name: https://humanitysatlas.com/who?q={name}
- Community (auto-graded public lives): https://humanitysatlas.com/community
- Classroom pack: https://humanitysatlas.com/classroom
